svg.title: The four Claude Fable 5.2 API changes that can break code written for Fable 5.1
svg.text: Four ways a model-ID swap turns into a 400 error
Fable 5.1 to 5.2, per Anthropic's docs. Claude Code, claude.ai and the Agent SDK handle these for you.
Edit, reorder or drop an earlier message, the system prompt or tools,
and returning thinking blocks fail with a 400. Fable 5.1 only enforced it on newer accounts.
Fable 5.2 reads older models' reasoning, but only Mythos 5.2 reads Fable 5.2's.
Routers that fall back to Opus 5.5 or Fable 5.1 lose that reasoning silently.
The old computer use tool returns a 400 everywhere except Amazon Bedrock.
A Fable 5.2 executor accepts only a Fable 5.2 or Mythos 5.2 advisor.
Change the advisor model in new conversations, or the prefix check fails.
Also new: adaptive thinking is always on, and forced tool_choice returns a 400. Neither changes anything if you come from Fable 5.1.
